mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO admin_user_role(user_id,role_code) SELECT id,'super' FROM admin_user WHERE username=#{username}
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,contact,phone,address,audit_status AS auditStatus,business_status AS businessStatus, order_count AS orderCount,joined_at AS joinedAt,audit_reason AS auditReason, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store_photo p WHERE p.merchant_id=merchant.id) AS hasPhoto FROM merchant UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('revision:',m.id),r.name,r.contact,r.phone,r.address,r.status,'资料变更', m.order_count,m.joined_at,r.reason,r.image_data IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store_photo p WHERE p.merchant_id=m.id) FROM merchant_profile_revision r JOIN merchant m ON m.id=r.merchant_id WHERE r.status='待审核' ORDER BY id

SELECT id,name,phone,gender,available_time AS availableTime,audit_status AS auditStatus, deliveries,COALESCE((SELECT a.balance_cents FROM finance_account a WHERE a.id=r.id AND a.type='骑手'),r.balance_cents) AS balanceCents, joined_at AS joinedAt,audit_reason AS auditReason, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rider_student_card c WHERE c.rider_id=r.id) AS hasPhoto FROM rider r ORDER BY id

SELECT u.id,u.username,u.enabled,GROUP_CONCAT(r.code ORDER BY r.code) AS roles FROM admin_user u LEFT JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN admin_role r ON r.code=ur.role_code GROUP BY u.id, u.username,u.enabled ORDER BY u.id
SELECT code,name FROM admin_role ORDER BY code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user_role(user_id,role_code) SELECT id,#{role} FROM admin_user WHERE username=#{username}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user_role ur JOIN admin_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.role_code='super' AND u.enabled=TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id WHERE u.enabled=TRUE AND ur.role_code='super'
